source_profile.key_encoding: mapping_key is sha256(json_array(all seven normalized string values)); the KV _key is a separate hash of mapping_key, scope, cluster, profile and mapping_status

stream_ipfix_example.observation_domain_present: 0 or 1; presence is independent from value
stream_ipfix_example.observation_domain_id: empty when absent; preserve numeric 0 when present
stream_ipfix_example.vpn_id: separate VPN/VRF identity, not observation-domain identity; empty is hashed as an empty string
stream_ipfix_example.routing_domain: observed vpn_id or explicitly configured routing-domain token

source_profile.duplicate_behavior: More than one profile/scope/cluster result for a matching seven-part key is ambiguous. Missing mapping never falls back to default scope.

catalyst_client_snapshot.replay: identical payload collapses to earliest received_time; latest receipt is health only; unchanged poll and replay cannot be distinguished without a vendor poll ID

catalyst_client_snapshot.resolved_attachment: connectionStatus=connected, connectedNetworkDeviceType=Switch, and connectedNetworkDevice.interfaceName present; otherwise retain as incomplete/disconnected/unsupported evidence

flow_v2.counter_policy: V2 preserves raw exporter bytes, packets, sampling, ports, direction and MAC values. attachment.meraki_basis: meraki_association_flow only for unique latest source-time association within 900 seconds after association; equal-time AP/client claims are ambiguous
attachment.catalyst_basis: catalyst_client_snapshot only for raw type Wired, connected Switch with interface, from received_time through 3600 seconds, source freshness within 3600 seconds
attachment.roaming_and_conflicts: Choose latest time-valid event per source/authority/native ID before uniqueness; conflicting same-time claims fail closed; disconnected snapshots suppress earlier connected snapshots when present for the IP

topology.v2: adm_topology_v2; source-qualified device IDs and exact scope/cluster mapping. Flow session references do not create TLOC inventory, tunnel attribution or route links; separate option records require a verified scoped decoder envelope before support.

client_handoff.counts: Distinct represented raw-tuple handoff connections; not interchangeable with identity-deduplicated edge counts and not all network traffic.
client_handoff.completeness: Every represented connection has exactly one backend and supported basis. Relevant missing/capped input lists are captured before consumption; missing input status, inventory caps, scope conflicts, and serialization caps fail closed.
client_handoff.presentation: V2 client paths, Inspector and CSV use complete client-edge evidence only. Frontend aggregate forwarding edges never assign an individual client backend, receiving node or observer; multiple backends are connection subsets, not a packet route.

network_client_history.receipt_semantics: The observations query emits received_time from _indextime. For duplicate event keys within a bounded slice, the migration validator computes the expected minimum and maximum from those per-record received_time values. The history builder persists received_time as the minimum of prior and current receipts and latest_received_time as the maximum of prior and current receipts. latest_received_time is builder-generated, not an observations field. No collected_time is inferred; it is absent unless a source documents and emits an actual collector timestamp.
network_client_history.expected_row_query: | `adm_network_client_history_observations` | eval domain_kind=adm_domain_kind, profile=adm_profile | fields _key contract_version source source_authority native_id event_fingerprint client_mac client_ip scope cluster routing_domain domain_kind profile mapping_status source_time received_time collected_time event_type client_type connected_device_type attachment_status attachment_basis attachment_device_id attachment_device_name attachment_device_mac device_serial ssid_number interface quality_reason raw_ref

receipt_semantics_fields.received_time: minimum _indextime among this bounded slice and any existing row for the stable event key
receipt_semantics_fields.latest_received_time: maximum _indextime among this bounded slice and any existing row for the stable event key; created by the history builder, not the observations macro
receipt_semantics_fields.collected_time: absent for Catalyst and Meraki observations because these records do not provide a documented collector timestamp; never derive from _indextime

validation.status_query_rule: Execute status_query and require exactly one row with adm_kind=status and adm_catalog_invalid=0; zero or more adm_kind=result rows may accompany it. Then execute read_query and require a complete paged read with unique _key values and all listed fields. A complete empty catalog is exactly one persisted sentinel row with _key=adm-catalog-empty; non-empty catalogs must not contain that reserved key.
